verdict.rationale: TruffleHog's official CLI runs non-interactively. It supports flags such as `--only-verified`, `--results=verified,unknown` and `--fail`, so an agent can script a scan and gate on real, live-verified findings. TruffleHog's platform can also route findings to Jira or webhooks for issue filing. However, the pack never documents a machine-readable output format (e.g. JSON) for the CLI, and issue routing is described only for the web UI/scanner product, not for CLI output. missing for 10: documented JSON/structured CLI output for agent parsing, CLI-side issue filing or a documented findings schema, hands-on corroboration of an agent-driven workflow

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent run a scan headlessly via the CLI, parse machine-readable results, and file issues for real findings

citations.quote: for every secret trufflehog can classify, it can also log in to confirm if that secret is live or not
Route findings to Slack, Jira, email, or webhooks so the right people can act on them.
